parameters.name: AssetId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset that is associated with the event.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: EntityUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the entity that is associated with the event.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- desc: descending

- asc: ascending

parameters.name: OrderField
parameters.description:
The field to sort the event list by. Valid values:

- GmtModified: Sorts by modification time. This is the default value.

- ThreatScore: Sorts by threat score.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis & Response is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the member. The administrator can use this ID to view the data of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator account.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the event. Valid values:

- 0: unhandled

- 1: in progress

- 5: failed

- 10: handled

parameters.name: ThreadLevel
parameters.description:
The threat level of the event. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

- serious: high

- suspicious: medium

- remind: low
